answer: Each task is generated only after an agent commits, by hashing its commitment, a domain tag (knoll, timber, velvet), and a specified future drand quicknet round; the threshold-BLS pulse is verified before use. Because the pulse is unknown at commitment time, automated Sybil swarms cannot precompute answers or farm a reusable offline corpus. The beacon limits timing bias, while per-agent resource costs and commit-reveal checks provide Sybil resistance.
